allow.2.1a: A whole-number hypotenuse whose radicand stays within the benchmark's whole numbers up to 225 (MA.8.GR.1.1, Clarification 3) comes from one of four triangles — 3-4-5, 6-8-10, 5-12-13, 9-12-15 — each with its legs in either order: 8 versions. Part (b), a whole leg, has 21, and every other part of the test is over 100.
allow.2.1b: A whole-number leg whose radicand is a whole number up to 225 (MA.8.GR.1.1, Clarification 3) is one of 21 right triangles, from 5-3 to 113-112: c² − a² must be a perfect square of 15 or less. 21 versions.
